shared.text: Drag anywhere to move. Your weapons fire on their own.
Tap DASH (or tap with a second finger) to zip through danger.
Level up! Tap UPGRADE whenever you're ready to pick.
Tap BUILD (top left) to pause and see every upgrade you own.
A rift! Step in to fight a boss and win a power for this run.
Lure the Seeker Phage: let it chase you, run at the Carrier, then dash aside when it locks!
An elite! Kill it for a chest. Follow the gold arrow.
OUTBREAK is ready! Tap it: faster weapons, half damage, and nearby germs turn to gold.
Dash right before a hit for a PERFECT dodge: the dash comes back and you hit harder.
Dash 4 times back to back for OVERDRIVE: fast and untouchable.
Streak power! Keep killing without getting hit to grow it.

infection.text: Leave your land and loop back in to claim everything inside.
Germs on your land eat it back. Keep claiming!
Close a loop without getting hit for x2 XP.
Close it NOW, while it flashes, to stun every germ inside!

swarm.text: Some kills rise as allies that guard you.
Tap the swarm button by OUTBREAK to give orders: Guard you, Hunt germs, or Harvest XP.

nucleus.text: Germs march on the nucleus. Keep it alive for 12 waves!
Stand on a green pad, then tap a tower to build it.
Stand on a tower again to upgrade it.
